subTitle: Common questions about our automation and app development services.

faqs.question: Do you work with budget-constrained businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. We focus heavily on providing affordable solutions that big firms often overlook, allowing small to medium businesses to leverage advanced automation and custom applications without exorbitant costs.

faqs.question: Can you help us automate our highly niche workflow?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Niche and complex workflows are our specialty. Our agentic workflows and custom automation systems are tailor-made for specific operational requirements that rigid, off-the-shelf software can't handle.

faqs.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: We utilize modern web frameworks, leading AI agentic infrastructures, and versatile process automation tools. Whenever possible, we also leverage the Microsoft Data Platform, Power BI, and Azure to build robust data solutions when required.

faqs.question: Do you still offer your legacy data analytics services?
faqs.answer: Yes! While our offerings have expanded into automation and custom software, we still provide deep expertise in data analytics, data engineering, and visualization so you can keep transforming raw data into actionable insights.

faqs.question: How long does a custom app or automation project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on the complexity of the requirements. A straightforward automation might be deployed in weeks, while robust custom applications use a phased delivery approach. We always prioritize fast time-to-value and clear communication.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing support after the project is finished?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer flexible, retainer-based managed services. We provide ongoing monitoring, continuous iteration, and priority support for your automation pipelines and applications, ensuring they scale with your business.
